reviews.text: My experience. As an active advisor, my experience with Keen has been deeply frustrating due to what I feel are misaligned priorities. I felt dismissed by support, after they refused to remove an unfair review that I believed crossed professional boundaries, they asked me if I could post positive feedback for Keen on Trustpilot. This felt insulting when my own reputation on their platform was not being protected. In my daily work, I have found the blocking limits to be stifling, as they do not provide me with the level of control I need to feel comfortable managing difficult callers. I also face penalties for disconnecting from 'one-minute' readings, despite my profiles terms clearly stating how that wouldn’t be the right fit. That’s not a reasonable time frame especially for what’s being asked and the rudeness and back to back one minute calls. This creates a stressful environment where system metrics seem to matter more than advisor well-being. Technically, the platform feels outdated. The app lacks essential features like messaging and review visibility. Also, experienced what appear to be payment delays and fees that I do not see on other advisor platforms. Overall, I feel like an interchangeable part of a system that ignores feedback, and I urge Keen to earn positive reviews by providing better support to the advisors who keep the site running.

Original Review:
Pros: Better layout for reading chat transcripts than what is available on their website. 

Cons: Limited functionality. Payment for readings is confusing. Looks like only option is to pay in advance because the link says “Add Minutes” but it is actually a link to the option of paying before or after the reading. Some search filters do not work. Chat transaction list is locked to one inferior sort order and should offer options. The list begins sorting by the number of sessions you have had with advisors but when there are several advisors with the same quantity it seems to list those in random order. There is no back button so if you are reading a transcript and you accidentally leave a page you have to start over scrolling through the inferior listing order to return to where you were. Everything is linear so it requires you to take long trips through corridors when a better system could allow you to jump right to a location and remember where you were. It also takes a long time to access a large chat session list. You should only have to get to the list not download the content in order to see it. Long or short lists should take same amount of time. It is just text no graphics so should load quickly but it doesn’t. One other major flaw is that the advisor list doesn’t show present but busy advisors. The list only reflects advisors available now or away so you don’t know you only have to wait a short time for a desired advisor to become available. When comparing lists of chat transcripts between the app and the Keen website some advisor content is empty and the advisors status (available, busy, away) is blank. So there is a discrepancy between app content and website content.

Pro/Con: Depending on what you prefer the layout being limited to portrait orientation may or may not suit you.
